adapter.name: github-mcp
adapter.description: Generated MCP-AQL adapter for the official GitHub MCP server.

create_or_update_file.review_reason: Mixed create/update semantics mapped to UPDATE for the first generated adapter.

create_pull_request_with_copilot.review_reason: Copilot-assisted pull request creation is treated as workflow execution in the first pass.

issue_write.review_reason: issue_write spans create and update behavior; pinned to UPDATE pending finer-grained decomposition.

push_files.review_reason: push_files can create and update multiple files plus branch history in a single workflow, so the first golden-path adapter keeps it in EXECUTE rather than collapsing it into CREATE or UPDATE.

pull_request_review_write.review_reason: Review-write semantics are treated as UPDATE in the first pass.

sub_issue_write.review_reason: sub_issue_write is treated as UPDATE until the source server exposes narrower tool semantics.
